meta_title: Platinum Plumbing & Gas | Emergency Plumber Hull
meta_description: Platinum Plumbing & Gas Services in Hull. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and gas installations. Fast response, 24/7 available. Call now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Hull? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Gas Services Across Hull
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle every plumbing and heating job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We aim to reach you within 60 minutes and carry all common parts on the van for instant repairs.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted, commissioned, and guaranteed. We source efficient models and handle all pipework to get you warm quickly and cut your heating bills.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing keeps your warranty valid and catches faults before they fail. Emergency repairs available round the clock.

services.title: Central Heating System Upgrades
services.desc: Radiator issues, pump failures, and system balancing — we diagnose and repair to restore even heat throughout your home.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New tap installations, under-sink work, and water line routing for renovations. All pipework tested and certified for safety.

services.title: Gas Appliance Installation
services.desc: Gas hob, fire, or water heater installation by a Gas Safe engineer. Full certification and safety checks included as standard.

about_pullquote: I started this business to show Hull families that emergency plumbing doesn't have to be expensive.
about_para_1: Platinum Plumbing & Gas Services was founded to bring honest, fast emergency plumbing to Hull residents and local businesses. With over eight years in the trade and hundreds of successful repairs and installations behind us, we've built a reputation for turning up when we say we will and fixing problems properly the first time.
about_para_2: Our Gas Safe registration and commitment to transparent pricing mean you'll never be shocked by the bill. We pride ourselves on being the plumber Hull homeowners call first — not last. That's why so many customers come back to us year after year for their annual boiler service and routine work.
reviews_heading: What Hull Homeowners Say About Platinum Plumbing

reviews.text: Midnight on a Sunday and our boiler packed in. Called Platinum and they were here within an hour. Brilliant service, sorted it quickly, and the price was fair. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe under the kitchen and was panicking. The team arrived same day, fixed it properly, and explained what had happened so we can avoid it next time. Professional and friendly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Had my annual boiler service done last month. Very thorough check, no hidden charges, and they even spotted a small issue before it became a big problem. Great value and peace of mind.
reviews.author: David M.
